svg.title: Reliability before and after independent calibration
svg.desc: Reliability diagrams on the same 100 synthetic test groups. Five fixed probability bins are used; per-bin counts are preserved in results.json. The raw fitted group logits were deliberately multiplied by 2.5 for this teaching experiment. Temperature was fit on 80 separate validation groups, never these test labels. A connected line is descriptive, not proof of calibration between points.
